hero.title: AI at the service of your
hero.description: Fursa combines artificial intelligence and a deep understanding of the local market to connect Tunisian talent with the best opportunities.

features.description: Our technology goes beyond keywords to understand the true value of each profile and the specific needs of Tunisian companies.
features.item1Text: Fursa AI reads CVs in French, Arabic and English. It automatically extracts skills, experience and education with unmatched precision.
features.item2Text: No more keyword searches. Our algorithm understands context. A 'Front-end Developer' intelligently matches an offer for 'React Engineer'.
features.item3Text: A conversational assistant available 24/7 to prepare for interviews, improve your CV or target the best opportunities in the Tunisian market.
features.chatBotMessage: Hello! I can see you are looking for a Full Stack Developer role in Sfax. Would you like me to review your CV for current standards?
features.chatUserMessage: Yes please. I added my Node.js experience.
features.chatReply: I reformulated the impact of your projects. I also found 3 opportunities at Digital Mania and Proxym that match at 90%+!
